title: The Intern
overview: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: Following a localized string of youth abductions and homicides, a cynical newspaper editor forms a desperate alliance with a law enforcement officer and three investigative journalists to track a missing child, uncovering a malevolent force that forces them to choose between self-preservation and lethal sacrifice.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Orang Perang
overview: The struggles of the Senoi Praaq team, a secret unit under the Royal Malaysian Police (PDRM) made up of the Orang Asli community, specifically the Semai and Temiar tribes.

title: Bisikan Nafsu
overview: UR is a famous Romantic Ustaz who is married to Alyssa who has a daughter named Nadia. Unbeknownst to Alyssa, UR is apparently a playboy. In secret, UR has also had a relationship with Alyssa's best friend, Aida. Alyssa caught UR with Aida, but due to their boundless love, Alyssa has forgiven UR and is still faithful to each other.

title: Primetime
overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, turning an undercover investigation into one of the most controversial cultural phenomena of the decade.

title: Other Mommy
overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: Kudrat 1968: High Council
overview: Prequel film to Project: High Council (2023).
